classification.read_rule: Only a valid 0/1 cached byte with existing actor classification and rechecked positive ward flag is accepted. Invalid ward bytes do not disable hero classification. Resource IDs are not used to guess wards.

position: Current sync coordinate or identity-matched pure native ActorMgr lookup and Q14 logic transform through the existing layout-3 Battle root.

drawing.filter: Enemy camp, non-hero confirmed ward, positive known current HP, valid object ID and current map coordinate. Friendly, neutral, duplicate, dead, unknown life state and invalid coordinates excluded.
drawing.icon: Small eye shape drawn with CoreGraphics. Hero health arcs remain red.
drawing.hero_metrics: Ward markers and edge clamps are excluded from hero roster, marker and HP-ring counts.

diagnostics.snapshot: is_ward and ward_classification_read_ok; minimap.wards counters and valid_ward_position_count
diagnostics.trace: Separate wards list, at most 16 per sample; existing 512 KiB total budget and 32-sample cap.

scope: Implementation and offline evidence only. The previous 0.7.9 reports did not collect the ward flag. Only wards represented in the currently enumerated client objects can be displayed; unseen, destroyed or server-only objects are not invented. Real ward types, placement/destruction and fog behavior need device samples.
